content.title: Tipoff time, TV channel set for Michigan-Tennessee in Elite Eight
content.text: Wolverines BasketballUpdated: Mar. 28, 2026, 1:34 a.m.Published: Mar. 28, 2026, 12:50 a.m.871/87Michigan basketball faces on Alabama in the Sweet 16 at United Center in Chicago on Friday, March 27 2026.By Andrew Kahn | akahn1@mlive.comCHICAGO — One win from the Final Four, Michigan learned its next tip time.The Wolverines play Sunday at 2:15 p.m. ET on CBS against Tennessee at the United Center. Like Michigan’s 90-77 win over Alabama on Friday, Andrew Catalon will serve as the play-by-play broadcaster alongside analyst Steve Lappas and sideline reporter Evan Washburn.Duke and UConn will play in the other regional final Sunday, in Washington, D.C (5:05 p.m., CBS).Two Big Ten teams, Illinois and Iowa, will play for another Final Four spot Saturday. Arizona and Purdue will meet for the other later that night.The Wolverines, the 1 seed in Midwest Region, have won has three straight. They beat Howard 101-80 and Saint Louis 95-72 in the opening rounds in Buffalo. Against Alabama, Michigan’s Yaxel Lendeborg posted 23 points, 12 rebounds, and seven assists to help the Wolverines advance. They dominated the second half, outscoring Alabama 43-28, to do it.Tennessee, a 6 seed, beat 2 seed Iowa State 76-62 on Friday. Nate Ament scored 18 for Tennessee (25-11). The Volunteers beat a play-in winner, Miami Ohio, before topping Virginia in Philadelphia.Michigan is looking to reach its first Final Four since 2018.
